say:2:1041502701:1.text: Temesia, the apples you bought but forgot at my place are about to rot. Still want them?
say:2:1041502701:1.source_cn: 特弥希娅，你之前买的苹果还放在我这里，快要坏掉了，你还要吗？

say:3:1041502702:1.text: Right, apples! Sorry, I completely forgot. Any good ones left? I'll take a few.
say:3:1041502702:1.source_cn: 啊，苹果！抱歉，我完全忘了，还有好的吗？给我拿几个。

say:4:1041502703:1.text: Apples are Dawn's favorite food, but Atalanta has replaced them with carrots lately, and that made Dawn mad...
say:4:1041502703:1.source_cn: 晨曦那孩子特别爱吃这些，最近阿塔兰忒总拿胡萝卜代替，晨...

choice_prompt:5:1041502703.text: Apples are Dawn's favorite food, but Atalanta has replaced them with carrots lately, and that made Dawn mad...
choice_prompt:5:1041502703.source_cn: 晨曦那孩子特别爱吃这些，最近阿塔兰忒总拿胡萝卜代替，晨曦都生气了……

say:6:1041502704:1.text: Ah, lately we've been teaming up because Atalanta is quite good at gathering intelligence...
say:6:1041502704:1.source_cn: 啊，我们最近偶尔会结伴行动，因为阿塔兰忒很擅长打听情报……

say:7:1041502706:1.text: Atalanta complained yesterday that the porridge I made tasted worse than what I fed Dawn...
say:7:1041502706:1.source_cn: 昨天阿塔兰忒还跟我抱怨，我煮的粥还不如给晨曦的饲料好喝……

say:8:1041502707:1.text: Porridge... You mean the apple-egg porridge?
say:8:1041502707:1.source_cn: 你煮的粥……你是说，燕麦苹果鸡蛋粥吗？

choice_prompt:9:1041502707.text: Porridge... You mean the apple-egg porridge?
choice_prompt:9:1041502707.source_cn: 你煮的粥……你是说，燕麦苹果鸡蛋粥吗？

say:10:1041502708:1.text: Well, sometimes I'd throw some corn and beans in as well...
say:10:1041502708:1.source_cn: 不、不只是这样，偶尔我也会加上玉米和大豆……

say:11:1041502709:1.text: ...Actually, I was too busy to cook anything but wanted something hot to eat...
say:11:1041502709:1.source_cn: 好吧，其实就是在此前忙碌的时候，因为没什么时间处理伙食...

say:12:1041502710:1.text: So I'd help myself to a scoop when I made food for Dawn.
say:12:1041502710:1.source_cn: 所以就趁着给晨曦煮食物时自己舀一碗出来。

say:13:1041502711:1.text: Bu-But I promise, it tastes pretty good!
say:13:1041502711:1.source_cn: 但、但是，我可以保证，味道很不错哦？

say:14:1041502712:1.text: I can promise that even Dawn didn't think much of the taste...
say:14:1041502712:1.source_cn: 我也可以保证，就连晨曦都觉得那个味道不怎么样……

say:15:1041502713:1.text: Horses love those ingredients, so I've no idea how you got it to taste that bad.
say:15:1041502713:1.source_cn: 明明每种材料都是马的最爱，不知道你怎么煮出来的。

choice_prompt:16:1041502713.text: Horses love those ingredients, so I've no idea how you got it to taste that bad.
choice_prompt:16:1041502713.source_cn: 明明每种材料都是马的最爱，不知道你怎么煮出来的。

say:17:1041502714:1.text: You noticed too, eh? Just a moment ago, her name was mentioned by Temesia with alarming frequency.
say:17:1041502714:1.source_cn: 您也发现了吧？从刚才开始，就异常高频地出现在特弥希娅话...

say:18:1041502715:1.text: In fact, Temesia has been venturing out on missions alone for the past few days...
say:18:1041502715:1.source_cn: 事实上，特弥希娅这几天的任务，似乎都是独自进行的哦？

say:19:1041502716:1.text: Uh, sorry, Atalanta and I just happen to travel together occasionally when we have the same goal in mind...
say:19:1041502716:1.source_cn: 呃，抱歉，抱歉，我与阿塔兰忒只是偶尔结伴同行，为了同样...

say:20:1041502717:1.text: Don't worry, Lucius! We'll always be the best duo in the Templar Knights!
say:20:1041502717:1.source_cn: 放心吧，卢修斯！我们永远是圣堂骑士中最好的搭档！

say:21:1041502718:1.text: Don't try to play it off... I don't mind working alone. And as a friend, I'm also happy to see you reconcile with Atalanta.
say:21:1041502718:1.source_cn: 别这么欲盖弥彰……我不介意单独行动，特弥希娅，你与阿塔...

say:22:1041502719:1.text: However, even I, occasionally, must break the virtue of humble silence that the Templar Knights uphold...
say:22:1041502719:1.source_cn: 只不过，就算是我，偶尔也要违反一下圣堂骑士谦虚沉默的美德……

say:23:1041502720:1.text: Atalanta's been mentioned more times than Dawn now!
say:23:1041502720:1.source_cn: 你提到阿塔兰忒的次数，已经比晨曦要更高了！

choice_prompt:24:1041502720.text: Atalanta's been mentioned more times than Dawn now!
choice_prompt:24:1041502720.source_cn: 你提到阿塔兰忒的次数，已经比晨曦要更高了！

say:25:1041502721:1.text: Of course! You've seen Dawn. What a powerful, beautiful horse she is!
say:25:1041502721:1.source_cn: 那当然？！您见过晨曦的，那是一匹多么强大而美丽的马儿！

say:26:1041502722:1.text: I'll even share my crown with her if she wants...
say:26:1041502722:1.source_cn: 如果它愿意，我甚至可以与它共享我的翼冠……

say:27:1041502723:1.text: Too bad she's way too picky. Other than the armor Temesia chose, she doesn't like anything else on her... though that could also be considered one of her virtues!
say:27:1041502723:1.source_cn: 可惜，它太过挑剔，除了特弥希娅选中的铠甲外，不喜欢其他...

say:28:1041502724:1.text: ...Okay, I apologize. I'll finish the mission as soon as possible and come see you at the temple with Dawn, so don't worry, Lucius.
say:28:1041502724:1.source_cn: ……好、好吧，我道歉，我会尽快结束任务，带着晨曦回圣堂...

choice:24:0:1.text: Are you standing up for a horse?
choice:24:0:1.male: Are you standing up for a horse?
choice:24:0:1.female: Are you standing up for a horse?

say:30:1041502705:1.text: My horse. She has a bad temper and is a picky eater... But overall, she's a good girl.
say:30:1041502705:1.source_cn: 是我的马，它脾气不好，而且特别挑嘴——不过总而言之还是...
